timingScope: Each strategy run serially, single observation. solveSeconds measures solveFlow setup, turbulence callbacks, SIMPLE iterations and final diagnostics; excludes CM2D reading, initial FV construction and evidence export. No memory measurement in this stage.

additionalRun.note: No nested 3844-cell run: projected cost exceeds the 90-second budget.

initialFailure.reason: Tampered JSON momentumResidual=0 was inside the old independent summary absolute allowance after interleaving reduced residuals.
initialFailure.fix: Require exact equality of the duplicated 17-digit native summary/history value, retain independent reconstruction and original solver gates.

verification.peerReview: Luna bounded read-only coupling review; no provable false acceptance found; independent field audit covers current coefficients and momentum.

limitations: Experimental steady incompressible SST-2003m channel only; no physical accuracy, y+ or grid independence qualification.
No 100k-cell SST run; one timing observation per strategy, not a universal speed guarantee.
No peak memory measurement for this stage.
Desktop remains 0.4.11; no product SST GUI, no SST checkpoint; no Linux/Windows/OpenFOAM run.
TMR published flatplate SST reference is SST-Vm and compressible M=0.2; current SST-2003m incompressible model needs a carefully matched comparison.
next: Flat-plate mixed boundaries, near-wall mesh/y+, matched-reference validation, and workspace/assembly reuse; long engineering CFD goal remains active.
